content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Category & Unit-wise Details
content_sections.text: Vacancies are divided into two categories - Fresher (163 posts) and Ex-ITI (4,308 posts) - spread across Carriage & Wagon Works Perambur, Central Workshop Ponmalai, Signal & Telecommunication Workshop Podanur, Railway Hospital Perambur, and multiple divisions (Chennai, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Palakkad, Salem, Trivandrum). Fresher Category - Unit-wise Total Ex-ITI Category - Group-wise Total Note: the Fresher category-wise sum (UR 68 + OBC 43 + SC 24 + ST 13 + EWS 14) computed from the source table equals 162, one less than the stated total of 163. The Ex-ITI category-wise sum (UR 1,744 + OBC 1,144 + SC 628 + ST 319 + EWS 394) computed from the source table equals 4,229, which is 79 less than the stated total of 4,308. Both discrepancies are in the source document and should be verified before publishing. A full trade-wise and unit-wise breakdown (individual trades like Fitter, Welder, Electrician, COPA, Draughtsman, MMTM, etc., with UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD splits for each of the ~15 units) runs across several pages of the notification and is not reproduced trade-by-trade here for readability - candidates should check the full notification PDF for their specific unit and trade. The notification also clarifies that vacancies are tentative and subject to change, and reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD is as per prescribed norms.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only candidates residing within the following areas (Geographical Jurisdiction of Southern Railway) are eligible to apply: Whole State of Tamil Nadu Whole Union Territory of Puducherry Whole State of Kerala Whole Union Territories of Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep Islands Only two districts of Andhra Pradesh: SPSR Nellore and Chittoor Only one district of Karnataka: Dakshina Kannada Candidates must also meet the minimum standards of physical fitness under Schedule-II of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, verified through a medical certificate from a Government-Authorized Doctor at the time of document verification.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Qualification
content_sections.text: Fresher Category: Fitter, Painter, Welder - Passed 10th Class (minimum 50% aggregate) under the 10+2 system or equivalent. Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology/Pathology/Cardiology) - Passed 12th Class (minimum 50% aggregate) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. Ex-ITI Category: Most trades (Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman-Civil, Instrument Mechanic, Mech. R&AC, Gas Cutter, MMTM, Structural Welder) - Passed 10th Class (min. 50%) + ITI course in the relevant trade with an NCVT/SCVT certificate. Electrician - Same as above, with Science as a subject in 10th. Electronics Mechanic - Same as above, with Science (Physics & Chemistry) and Mathematics. Secretarial Assistant & Stenographer (English) - Passed 12th Class + ITI course with NCVT/SCVT certificate. ICTSM - Passed 10th Class + ITI course with NCVT/SCVT certificate. COPA/PASAA - Passed 10th Class (min. 50%) + National Trade Certificate in Computer Operator and Programming Assistant. Note: The minimum 50% requirement in 10th standard does not apply to SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAAs), Engineering Graduates/Diploma holders, or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of training/job experience after these qualifications are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on the date of notification (28-08-2026): Minimum age: 15 years completed Maximum age: 22 years (Fresher/Ex-ITI) / 24 years (MLT) Upper age relaxation: 3 years for OBC-(NCL), 5 years for SC/ST, 10 years for PwBD Combined relaxation for PwBD candidates: UR/EWS + PwBD = 10 years; OBC-(NCL) + PwBD = 13 years; SC/ST + PwBD = 15 years To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend increases by 10% in the second year of training and a further 15% in the third year, over the prescribed minimum.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: Processing fee of Rs. 100/- (non-refundable), payable online. No fee is required for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a Merit List, prepared as follows: Fresher Category: Matriculation marks converted to 200 (minimum 50% aggregate required, except SC/ST/PwBD). Ex-ITI Category: Matriculation marks converted to 100 + ITI marks converted to 100 = 200 total, with equal weightage to both. MLT Category: Higher Secondary marks (Physics, Chemistry, Maths & Biology) converted to 200. In case of a tie, the older candidate is preferred; if birth dates are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier is preferred.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Southern Railway Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit www.sr.indianrailways.gov.in Navigate to News & Updates → Personnel Branch Information Complete the online application in all respects before the closing date. Submit the application online between 28-08-2026 and 27-09-2026 (till 17:00 Hrs).

All official communication - notifications, document verification lists, selection and eligibility results - will be posted only on the official website link mentioned above. faq.question: Q1. What is Southern Railway Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Southern Railway's engagement of candidates as Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for training in designated trades across its Divisions/Workshops/Units (Notification No. 01/2026).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The notification states 4,471 total posts (163 Fresher + 4,308 Ex-ITI); note the category-wise figures in the source table sum to slightly different totals (162 and 4,229 respectively) – this discrepancy should be verified before publishing.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 27 September 2026, till 5:00 PM, online only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: It varies by trade and category – ranging from 10th pass with 50% marks (Fresher trades like Fitter/Painter/Welder) to 10th/12th pass plus a relevant ITI certificate (Ex-ITI trades).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 15 to 22 years (24 years for MLT), as on the notification date, with relaxations for OBC-NCL, SC/ST, and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, Rs. 100/- non-refundable, waived for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Through www.sr.indianrailways.gov.in → News & Updates → Personnel Branch Information, between 28-08-2026 and 27-09-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A merit list based on Matriculation marks (plus ITI marks for Ex-ITI candidates, or Higher Secondary marks for MLT candidates).

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for Act Apprentices?
faq.answer: Rs. 8,200/month (Fresher–10th std), Rs. 9,600/month (Fresher–12th std and Ex-ITI), increasing in years 2 and 3 of training.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only candidates residing within Southern Railway's specified jurisdiction – the whole of Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Kerala; the Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep UTs; SPSR Nellore and Chittoor districts of Andhra Pradesh; and Dakshina Kannada district of Karnataka.
